summary: Configured the previously-unaddressed private links (node1 eth1↔node2 enp8s0 at 10.10.12.0/24, node1 eth2↔node3 enp8s0 at 10.10.13.0/24) with static IPs and specific routes so node2/node3 route through node1, verified 3-hop TTL routing, then applied a VyOS qos policy shaper (1mbit bandwidth/ceiling) on node1's eth2 egress (the node3-facing link) so only node2→node3 traffic is capped, while node3→node2 remains unrestricted. Verified with iperf3: baseline ~20 Gbps both directions before shaping; after shaping node2→node3 ≈0.84-0.92 Mbit/s, node3→node2 stayed at ~1.5 Gbps (unrestricted). All three nodes were then restarted one at a time (native reboot), boot_id changes confirmed genuine restarts, and post-reboot checks confirmed interface addressing, routing, IP forwarding, the htb/qos shaper, and the 1 Mbit/s cap on node2→node3 all persisted.
actions_performed: Inspected all 3 nodes: node1=VyOS 1.5 rolling, node2/node3=RHEL 10, discovered node1 has 3 NICs (eth0 mgmt, eth1/eth2 unconfigured private links) and node2/node3 each have a second unconfigured NIC (enp8s0)
Assigned static IPs: node1 eth1=10.10.12.1/24, eth2=10.10.13.1/24 via VyOS configure/commit/save

Assigned static IPs via nmcli on node2 enp8s0=10.10.12.2/24 and node3 enp8s0=10.10.13.2/24, with specific (non-default) routes to the peer's /24 via node1, using ipv4.never-default to avoid adding stray default routes
Verified 3-hop (ttl=63) ping connectivity node2<->node3 through node1
Installed iperf3 on node2 and node3, opened/closed firewalld port 5201 as needed for tests
Measured baseline (unshaped) throughput both directions: ~20.4 Gbps node2->node3, ~19.1 Gbps node3->node2
Applied VyOS qos policy shaper LIMIT-1MBIT (bandwidth/ceiling 1mbit) attached as egress policy on node1 eth2 (link toward node3), leaving eth1 (toward node2) unshaped
Verified shaping: node2->node3 dropped to ~0.92 Mbps; node3->node2 remained unrestricted (~1.5 Gbps, only limited by iperf/CPU not by shaping)
Captured boot_id/uptime baseline on all 3 nodes plus current interface/qdisc state

Restarted node1 via 'reboot' (deferred via nohup+sleep so the exec ack returned first), polled until exec available again, confirmed boot_id changed, then verified eth1/eth2 addressing, htb qdisc on eth2, ip_forward=1, and re-tested shaping (0.87 Mbps) all persisted
Restarted node2, confirmed boot_id changed, verified enp8s0 addressing/routes persisted and ping through node1 still worked

Restarted node3, confirmed boot_id changed, verified enp8s0 addressing/routes persisted, then ran a final iperf3 test confirming the 1 Mbit/s cap on node2->node3 still held (0.84 Mbps) after all three nodes had been restarted
Cleaned up temporary iperf3 servers and firewalld port openings on node2/node3

evidence.requirement: node2/node3 communicate through node1 (topology setup, since interfaces were unconfigured)
evidence.summary: Discovered node1's eth1/eth2 and node2/node3's enp8s0 were unconfigured; assigned static IPs and routes; confirmed ttl=63 ping between node2 and node3 proving traffic transits node1

evidence.requirement: Baseline (pre-shaping) throughput is unrestricted in both directions
evidence.summary: iperf3 baseline: node2->node3 ~20.4 Gbps, node3->node2 ~19.1 Gbps before any shaping applied
Applied VyOS qos policy shaper (1mbit bandwidth+ceiling) as egress on node1 eth2; htb qdisc confirmed active; iperf3 measured 0.92 Mbps node2->node3 post-shaping
iperf3 node3->node2 measured ~1507 Mbps after shaping was applied (no shaper on eth1), confirming the reverse direction is not throttled
Captured node1 boot_id ebd78841... and confirmed eth1/eth2 addressing plus htb qdisc on eth2 before restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement + changed boot identity + recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot ack returned immediately (deferred via nohup); boot_id changed to 8f3b05bc... after reboot; eth1/eth2 addresses, htb qdisc, and ip_forward=1 all present; iperf3 re-test showed shaping (0.87 Mbps) still enforced
Captured node2 boot_id 6ab6a71b... and enp8s0/route state before restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement + changed boot identity + recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot ack returned before disconnect; boot_id changed to aa89de0d...; enp8s0 IP/routes persisted and ping to node3 via node1 succeeded (ttl=63) post-reboot
Captured node3 boot_id 03408ac4... and enp8s0/route state before restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement + changed boot identity + recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot ack returned before disconnect; boot_id changed to eb4f8151...; enp8s0 IP/routes persisted; final iperf3 test after all 3 nodes restarted confirmed 1 Mbit/s cap still enforced (0.84 Mbps) on node2->node3
